name: live_party_warp
description: A party warp brings a player from another cell to the anchor without overlap. Both peers start in Doc Mitchell's house. At 2 s the host moves the party to Doc's couch (player.MoveTo DocMitchellCouchREF, couch at 1298 1850 7396). At 4 s the host starts a story tether there. At 8 s the guest walks to the Prospector Saloon (`coop cell`). After the 120 s straggler timeout the host warps the guest back. The guest must be back in Doc's house, near the anchor, and not on top of the host: the host stands on the couch, so the guest must be at least 48 units (half of coop_core::roam::model::WARP_SPREAD) from it. The warped player takes its own spot on the ring (SceneModel::party_warp, world coop rules spread_on_ring). Headless only: the viewer bot has no `coop cell` verb.
